note.fr: Vérifiez les exigences de diplôme d'entrée : havo, vwo ou mbo niveau 4 (avec un diplôme marocain, contactez Avans pour l'admission).
note.en: Check the prior education requirements: havo, vwo or mbo level 4 (with a Moroccan diploma, contact Avans about admission).

evidence.quote: Dat kan alleen als je een havo-, vwo- of mbo niveau 4-diploma hebt.

note.en: For non-EEA students the Studiekeuzecheck (intake) is compulsory; check deadlines and required documents.

notes: Deadlines: the pages only give general application deadlines without saying they are for non-EU/foreign-qualification applicants, so no intake date is included. Tuition: the programme page does not state a non-EU fee; the institution-wide fee page gives the institutional fee for bachelor's programmes for 2026-2027 (non-EEA), which the task allows.
